articles.title: R Ashoka alleges irregularities in Rs 133-crore Bengaluru waste management tender
articles.description: Bengaluru waste tender: Karnataka BJP leader R Ashoka has alleged irregularities in a Rs 133-crore waste management contract, claiming an ineligible firm was favoured and security deposits were waived despite warnings.

articles.title: R. Ashok seeks probe into alleged irregularities in waste management tenders
articles.description: R. Ashok alleges irregularities in Bengaluru waste management tenders, demanding a high-level probe into alleged favoritism and eligibility breaches.

articles.title: The Tender247 Story: Turning tender intelligence into a competitive advantage with Anupam Kher
articles.description: Harnessing the power of AI, Tender247 is transforming the landscape for businesses seeking tender opportunities on government platforms. Appointing Anupam Kher as its brand ambassador, the company focuses on simplifying the tender process for smaller businesses. The initiative promises to enhance decision-making capabilities and facilitate greater access to public procurement contracts, resulting in a more inclusive bidding environment.

articles.title: TheTenders Offers Comprehensive Tender Bidding Support and GeM Portal Services to Help Businesses Access Government Opportunities
articles.description: New Delhi [India], October 23: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is an online public procurement platform that enables eligible sellers, manufacturers, contractors, and service providers to offer goods and services to government departments and other authorised buyers. Businesses can explore GeM Tenders in India and participate in procurement opportunities according to the applicable eligibility criteria, tender conditions, and platform policies.
